events.title: Influencer Recommendation
events.text: A city influencer posted about your store. Foot traffic surges for two days.

events.title: Viral Negative Review
events.text: A harsh review is trending. Respond publicly or ride it out?

events.title: Festival Weekend
events.text: The city festival floods the streets. All districts see more shoppers.

events.title: University Exams
events.text: Exam season empties University Row but boosts calm wellness products.

events.title: Wellness Convention
events.text: A wellness convention is in town. Wellness Heights demand spikes.

events.title: Supplier Shortage
events.text: A supplier cooperative reports shortages. Input prices climb this week.

events.title: Packaging Rule Update
events.text: The city updated packaging rules. Adapt immediately or risk compliance.

events.title: Utility Price Surge
events.text: Energy prices spike citywide. Utilities cost more for a few days.

events.title: Competitor Discount Campaign
events.text: A rival chain slashes prices. Price-sensitive customers wander off.

events.title: Product Recall Scare
events.text: A supplier upstream issued a recall. Prove your lot tracking is clean.

events.title: Staff Illness Wave
events.text: A cold wave hits the team. Morale and energy dip.

events.title: Equipment Failure
events.text: A power spike damaged a machine on the floor.

events.title: Surprise Audit
events.text: City inspectors walked in unannounced.

events.title: Tourism Boom
events.text: A travel magazine featured Verdantia. Tourists everywhere.

events.title: District Construction
events.text: Roadworks choke a district. Deliveries and foot traffic slow down.

events.title: Charity Opportunity
events.text: The Verdantia Youth Fund asks for a sponsorship.

events.title: Limited Input Auction
events.text: A rare lot of Northern Glass inputs is on auction.

events.title: Landlord Negotiation
events.text: Your landlord offers a deal: prepay rent for a discount.

events.title: Data-System Outage
events.text: The city data network hiccups. Remote systems fall back to local mode.

events.title: Delivery Delay
events.text: A highway closure delays supplier deliveries this week.

events.title: Heat Wave
events.text: A heat wave rolls in: beverages boom, machines strain.

events.title: Employee Dispute
events.text: Two team members clash over shift priorities.

events.title: Investor Offer
events.text: An investor offers quick cash for a slice of future goodwill.

events.title: Sustainability Grant
events.text: The city grants efficient operators a sustainability bonus.

events.title: New Competitor Opening
events.text: A flashy competitor opened across town.

events.title: Local News Interview
events.text: A journalist wants a tour of your facility.

events.title: Grey Rain Week
events.text: A week of drizzle keeps casual shoppers home.

events.title: Street Food Fair
events.text: A food fair beside Old Market spills hungry crowds into your store.

events.title: City Marathon
events.text: Marathon day: wellness products surge, roads close.

events.title: Gallery Opening Night
events.text: The Arts Quarter celebrates. Limited editions are the ticket.

events.title: Green Power Deal
events.text: A co-op offers discounted clean power for a signup fee.

events.title: Bulk Input Offer
events.text: A supplier clears warehouse space: discounted seed kits today.

events.title: Mystery Shopper
events.text: The retail association sent a mystery shopper. Results go public.

events.title: Label Printing Error
events.text: A misprint batch slipped through. Fix labels before inspectors notice.

events.title: Radio Feature
events.text: A local radio host praised your storefront rebrand.

events.title: Cold Snap
events.text: Freezing days push customers toward teas and edibles.

events.title: Supplier Loyalty Bonus
events.text: Your steady orders earned a supplier credit.

events.title: Intern Program
events.text: The university proposes an intern program.

events.title: Night Market License
events.text: Verdantia trials night markets. Extended hours, extra staff strain.

events.title: Efficiency Tax Rebate
events.text: The city rebates part of your taxes for efficient operation.

events.title: Rolling Blackout
events.text: A rolling blackout stalls part of the grid for a day.

events.title: Street Art Collab
events.text: A famous muralist offers to paint your storefront.
